title: Sauce Gardner says current calf injury isn't as bad as last year

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sauce Gardner says current calf injury isn't as bad as last year
sources.description: A calf injury kept Colts cornerback Sauce Gardner off the field for much of the seven-game losing streak that ended the 2025 season, so his appearance on Wednesday's injury report with another calf injury conjures up some bad memories.
